text: No, the method did not detect any tree-cover loss events on this property after 2020. The analysis, covering 2021–2025, found no losses of 0.5 hectares or larger within the 311.2-hectare asset. The data sources (Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020) confirmed stable forest cover, with 91.77% of the property classified as forest in 2020. However, smaller changes (under 0.5 ha) or those narrower than 30 meters might not be captured. The evidence does not confirm absolute compliance or rule out all possible changes, but no significant losses were observed.
